correctness.rationale: The n>=6 classification uses the connected occupied-column projection to prove at most two consecutive empty columns; separate empty counts 0,1,2 prove minimum n and exhaust A/B/C. The transition table is a complete occupancy-boundary case analysis of every one-for-one exchange, and its degrees plus constructed paths prove all invariants. Two independently represented standard-library checkers exhaustively verified n=6..11 by subset/edge enumeration and the exact template-neighbor table for n=6..38. Those finite checks support but do not replace the all-n proof.

value.rationale: The exact optimal-set landscape and one-swap mobility of minimum connected backbones is a natural nontrivial problem even after their minimum size is known. This resolves all optima for an infinite cubic family, proves connectivity via explicit legal routes, distinguishes two growing-degree hubs from bounded-degree bulk, gives a precise degree/edge enumerator, and proves an exact distance n between structurally opposite optimum solutions. These properties are not implied by a routine domination-number calculation.
